title: Separate uniqueness-point information from its telescoping frequency artifact
statement: Under one explicitly specified add-one regularization of the competing-prefix ratios, including the uniqueness-point segment makes the mean telescope exactly to log2(N - word_count + 1) divided by the uniqueness-point index. It is therefore algebraically coupled to frequency and uniqueness position, rather than an independent information measure. In 30,000-token public training samples from both ZL and IT, four historical books (three windows each), and five seeds each of three public-trained generators per transcription, all 220 length-specific fits (lengths 4–8) have positive type-frequency versus relative-uniqueness slopes and negative slopes for this regularized mean information. These exploratory signs alone do not distinguish the manuscript from these particular structured generators.
check: Before registering any hidden-page claim, identify the authors’ original implementation or justify another explicitly defined statistic that does not merely telescope to uniqueness position and frequency. Prove its relationship to those variables, validate hand-computed prefix trees including prefix-of-another-word boundaries, then calibrate the proposed statistic and fixed historical comparisons on independent samples and structured generators. Specify sampling, segmentation, weighting, uncertainty and minimum support before a hidden-page run. Do not treat this regularized convention as the authors’ documented method.
method: Use exactly 30,000 certain lowercase ASCII word tokens; raw character positions and types; type-weighted regressions separately by word length 4–8. Let C(p) be the token count of prefix p, C(empty)=N, and c the full word count. The uniqueness point u is the first prefix belonging to one type; if the complete word prefixes another type, u=length+1 and the last segment is an end marker. For every segment i up through u, compute -log2((C(prefix_i)-c+1)/(C(prefix_{i-1})-c+1)); the end marker has competing count zero. Average the u values. These ratios are an explicit add-one regularization, not a normalized conditional probability. The last numerator is 1, so all intermediate factors cancel and the exact mean is log2(N-c+1)/u. Compare the earlier finite-only convention in the task’s parent record; neither convention is confirmed as the paper’s implementation.

reproduce.command: Save script as /tmp/reproduce_pj025.py then run PYTHONPATH=. python3 /tmp/reproduce_pj025.py

limitations: The two witnesses transcribe the same manuscript; the three windows per historical source are not independent books. The generators are fit to the public training pages and written to their shape; these are structured controls, not independent fits to hidden pages. Five seeds per generator and no inferential test provide an exploratory sign comparison, not power or causal identification. The hidden pages were not used. The source implementation was not found in the searches performed; absence of a search result does not establish unavailability.
source: Layfield et al. 2020, Word Probability Findings in the Voynich Manuscript, https://aclanthology.org/2020.lt4hala-1.11/
